children: may retest a support at $2.9325 per lb, a break below which could open the way toward $2.8755.
The contract is riding on a wave c which has temporarily stopped around its 50% projection level of $2.9785. A weak bounce occurred, which seems to have ended around the resistance of $2.9785.
As long as this wave remains within the channel, it is likely to extend toward $2.7835. A break above $2.9785 may lead to a gain to $3.0245.
* The coffee report is published twice a week on Tuesday and Thursday.
